mcc.text: Skim milk flows along a fine ceramic membrane: the whey proteins, lactose and minerals go through, the casein micelles stay, and water is added and filtered out again to wash the whey proteins out.

nativeWhey.text: Skim milk is pushed along a fine ceramic membrane that lets the small whey proteins through and holds back the casein micelles, then washed with water in several stages so more serum protein follows. No rennet or acid is used, so the result is whey without glycomacropeptide.
